stem.en: A waterfall flows over hard rock with softer rock under it. Put the events in the right order.

text.en: Hard rock falls, then soft rock wears away, then a gap opens.

feedback.en: The hard rock cannot fall until the soft rock under it has gone.

text.en: A plunge pool fills up, then the river stops, then the rock breaks.

feedback.en: The pool is dug out by the falling water. The river does not stop.

text.en: Soft rock wears away, a gap opens, then the hard rock breaks.

feedback.en: Right. The hard rock loses its support and then falls.

text.en: The hard rock wears first, then the soft rock falls on top of it.

feedback.en: Hard rock resists erosion, so the soft rock wears first.

explanation.en: Soft rock wears away first and leaves a gap. The hard rock then sticks out with no support and breaks off, and the fall stands further upstream than before.

hints.en: Which rock resists the water, and which wears away first?
